QR Code generator library (C++)

`qrcodegen.hpp` and `qrcodegen.cpp` are unmodified copies of `cpp/qrcodegen.hpp` and `cpp/qrcodegen.cpp` from Project Nayuki's QR-Code-generator, tag `v1.8.0` (https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator). MIT License; the full license text is in the header of both files.

Used by `src/companion.cpp` to draw the pairing QR code of the companion app as SVG.
